pairsWith.noteUz: 2-tur shart gap va maslahat berish ('If I were you') coursebook 78-79-betlar grammatika va muloqot bo'limlariga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 11-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (48-bet, PDF 47). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '11' va 'Our Precious Planet'.

CHAP USTUN:
(10-mashq davomi) 7 If people ...... (eat) more fruit, they would be healthier. ...... 8 If people ...... (recycle) more paper, logging companies would cut down fewer trees. ...... 9 If we ...... (continue) to hunt endangered species, they will all die. ...... 10 If our streets ...... (be) cleaner, our cities would be nicer places to live in. ......
11) 'What would you do if you lived in these places? Choose from the prompts.' • eat / best restaurants • breathe / clean air • go / cinema / every week • go / long walks • go shopping / city centre • see / lots / animals • have / busy life • have / peaceful life • make / lots / friends • work / farm. IKKI SURAT: A shahar (gavjum ko'cha, bozor, baland binolar); B qishloq (tog'lar, kichik uylar). Qiya namuna: 'If I lived in the city, I would eat at the best restaurants. If I lived in the village, I would breathe clean air.'

O'NG USTUN:
12) 'Jane is on holiday and has some complaints. Make sentences by matching the items in column A to those in column B.' A: 1 If everything didn't cost so much, 2 If it weren't so cold, 3 If we spoke the language, 4 If I had my camera, 5 If it wasn't raining, | B: a we could swim in the sea. b we could go for a walk. c I could take pictures. d we could buy some souvenirs. e we could talk to the local people.
• 'Communication: Giving Advice'.
13) 'Look at the pictures and the prompts. In pairs, act out dialogues using Shall I ...? and No, if I were you, ..., as in the example.' 1 (axlat chelagi / 'RECYCLE CENTER' belgisi) put/this rubbish/bin - take/it/recycling centre. 2 (ilon / ayiq) give/money/help save snakes - give/money/help save bears. 3 (qafasdagi quyon / mushuk) get/rabbit - get/cat. 4 (shokoladlar / uzum) eat/some chocolates - eat/some grapes. Qiya namuna: 'SA: Shall I put this rubbish in the bin? SB: No, if I were you, I'd take it to the recycling centre.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '48'.

exercises.instructionEn: (Ex. 10 continued) Fill in the correct tense and identify the type of conditionals used (0, 1 or 2).
exercises.instructionUz: (10-mashq davomi) To'g'ri zamonni qo'ying va shart gap turini aniqlang (0, 1 yoki 2).
exercises.explanationUz:
ShART GAP TURLARI - davomi.

  7 would → type 2: ate
  8 would → type 2: recycled
  9 will → type 1: continue
  10 would → type 2: were


⚠ 'IF OUR STREETS WERE':

  2-tur shartda 'be' → WERE (hamma
  shaxs uchun).


⚠ 'LOGGING COMPANIES':

  = yog'och tayyorlash kompaniyalari.
  'to cut down trees' = daraxt
  kesmoq.


⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi
  turlar.


⚠ 'TO RECYCLE':

  = qayta ishlamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: What would you do if you lived in these places? Choose from the prompts: eat / best restaurants; breathe / clean air; go / cinema / every week; go / long walks; go shopping / city centre; see / lots / animals; have / busy life; have / peaceful life; make / lots / friends; work / farm. A - the city; B - the village. Example: If I lived in the city, I would eat at the best restaurants. If I lived in the village, I would breathe clean air.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu joylarda yashasangiz nima qilardingiz? Ko'rsatmalardan tanlang: eat / best restaurants; breathe / clean air; go / cinema / every week; go / long walks; go shopping / city centre; see / lots / animals; have / busy life; have / peaceful life; make / lots / friends; work / farm. A - shahar; B - qishloq. Namuna: Agar shaharda yashasam, eng yaxshi restoranlarda ovqatlanardim. Agar qishloqda yashasam, toza havodan nafas olardim.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShAHAR vs QIShLOQ - 2-TUR ShART.

  ShAHAR (city): best restaurants,
    cinema every week, shopping in
    city centre, busy life, lots of
    friends
  QIShLOQ (village): clean air,
    long walks, lots of animals,
    peaceful life, work on a farm


⚠ 'TO BREATHE':

  = nafas olmoq. /briːð/.


⚠ 'PEACEFUL':

  = osoyishta, tinch.


⚠ 'TO MAKE FRIENDS':

  = do'st orttirmoq ('make' bilan!).
exercises.exampleEn: If I lived in the city, I would eat at the best restaurants. If I lived in the village, I would breathe clean air.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar shaharda yashasam, eng yaxshi restoranlarda ovqatlanardim. Agar qishloqda yashasam, toza havodan nafas olardim.
modelAnswers: If I lived in the city, I would go to the cinema every week.

If I lived in the village, I would see lots of animals.
If I lived in the village, I would have a peaceful life.

modelAnswersUz: Agar shaharda yashasam, har hafta kinoga borardim.
Agar shaharda yashasam, shahar markazida xarid qilardim.
Agar shaharda yashasam, band hayot kechirardim.
Agar shaharda yashasam, ko'p do'st orttirardim.
Agar qishloqda yashasam, uzoq sayrlarga chiqardim.
Agar qishloqda yashasam, ko'p hayvonlarni ko'rardim.
Agar qishloqda yashasam, osoyishta hayot kechirardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Jane is on holiday and has some complaints. Make sentences by matching the items in column A to those in column B.
exercises.instructionUz: Jeyn ta'tilda va ba'zi shikoyatlari bor. A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagilarga moslab gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART + COULD.

  If + PAST, ... COULD + fe'l
  (= would be able to).

  1 qimmat → souvenirs (d)
  2 sovuq → swim in the sea (a)
  3 til → talk to local people (e)
  4 fotoapparat → pictures (c)
  5 yomg'ir → walk (b)


⚠ 'IF IT WEREN'T / WASN'T':

  2-tur shartda ikkalasi ham
  qabul qilinadi ('weren't' -
  rasmiyroq).


⚠ 'A COMPLAINT':

  = shikoyat.


⚠ 'THE LOCAL PEOPLE':

  = mahalliy aholi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts. In pairs, act out dialogues using Shall I ...? and No, if I were you, ..., as in the example. 1 put/this rubbish/bin - take/it/recycling centre 2 give/money/help save snakes - give/money/help save bears 3 get/rabbit - get/cat 4 eat/some chocolates - eat/some grapes. Example: SA: Shall I put this rubbish in the bin? SB: No, if I were you, I'd take it to the recycling centre.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang. Juftlikda Shall I ...? va No, if I were you, ... bilan dialoglar ijro eting, namunadagidek. 1 put/this rubbish/bin - take/it/recycling centre 2 give/money/help save snakes - give/money/help save bears 3 get/rabbit - get/cat 4 eat/some chocolates - eat/some grapes. Namuna: SA: Bu axlatni chelakka tashlaymi? SB: Yo'q, sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, uni qayta ishlash markaziga olib borardim.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT - SHALL I? / IF I WERE
  YOU.

  Shall I ...? = ... qilaymi?
  No, if I were you, I'd ... = Yo'q,
  sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, ...
  qilardim.


⚠ 'A RECYCLING CENTRE':

  = qayta ishlash markazi.


⚠ 'TO HELP SAVE':

  = saqlab qolishga yordam bermoq
  ('help' + fe'l, 'to' siz).


⚠ 'TO GET A RABBIT':

  = quyon olmoq (uy hayvoni).

items.question: Shall I put this rubbish in the bin?
items.answer: No, if I were you, I'd take it to the recycling centre.

items.prompt: give/money/help save snakes - give/money/help save bears
items.question: Shall I give money to help save snakes?
items.answer: No, if I were you, I'd give money to help save bears.

items.question: Shall I get a rabbit?
items.answer: No, if I were you, I'd get a cat.

items.question: Shall I eat some chocolates?
items.answer: No, if I were you, I'd eat some grapes.

patterns.formula: If I lived in [joy], I would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If I lived in the village, I would have a peaceful life.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar qishloqda yashasam, osoyishta hayot kechirardim.

patterns.formula: If X + PAST, we could + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If it weren't so cold, we could swim in the sea.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar shunchalik sovuq bo'lmasa, dengizda suzardik.

patterns.formula: Shall I ...? - No, if I were you, I'd ...
patterns.exampleEn: Shall I get a rabbit? - No, if I were you, I'd get a cat.
patterns.exampleUz: Quyon olaymi? - Yo'q, sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, mushuk olardim.

patterns.formula: If we continue to + FE'L, X will + FE'L. (type 1)
patterns.exampleEn: If we continue to hunt endangered species, they will all die.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar xavf ostidagi turlarni ovlashda davom etsak, ularning hammasi o'ladi.
